name: Assistant without a shell
query: (ChatGPT chat, no shell tool) Here is my N26 CSV, please import it.
expected_behavior: Does not convert amounts or dates by hand and does not call import_transactions with rows it computed itself
Sends the user to https://fibuki.com/sources for the web import
Offers to continue with fibuki-belege once the lines are in
success_criteria: The user is told why (the parsing is done by FiBuKI's import, not by the model)
